```python
from griffe import load

# Load the requests package using the module-level convenience entry point
requests_api = load("requests")

# Get all public top-level functions (exclude private members starting with _)
public_functions = [
    name for name, member in requests_api.members.items()
    if not name.startswith("_") and member.kind == "function"
]

# Print the names sorted alphabetically
for func_name in sorted(public_functions):
    print(func_name)
```
